bio_en: Mikayel Batalian, known as Mukhi, was the most prominent of the 'Banants trinity' - Mukhi, Mukel and Grigor - three inseparable young men of Banants village in the Ganja district who had served four years in the Russian army. They first distinguished themselves in the Armenian-Tatar clashes in the Jraberd (Gulistan) area and afterwards as ARF operatives. On 23 January 1907, during the assassination of the notorious police official Loladze, Mukhi was mortally wounded in the chest and managed to drag himself into the yard of the Armenian church, where he died. His grave was kept secret for a long time, even from his sister.
